'''Tyne's Horky''' was a rough, rowdy, and lawless frontier [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|town]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyne's Horky|of the same name]]. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kleb Zellock]] owned a piece of everything in town, and ran his [[Kleb Zellock's criminal empire|criminal empire]] out of [[Doodnik's Café]].

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The town of Tyne's Horky first appeared in "[[The Lost Prince]]," a [[1985]] episode of the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars Droids'']] television series. ''[[The Lost Prince: A Droid Adventure]]'', a children's book adaptation of the episode, identified Tyne's Horky as a frontier mining town. The [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] later applied that name and description to the town's planet, stating "Tyne's Horky is a small, uneventful mining planet on the frontier."
